q-43228.name: Question 1
q-43228.worked_solution:
To work out ${15}^{3},$ we multiply $15$ by itself and then multiply the result by $15$ once more:

$$
\begin{aligned}{15}^{3} & =15\cdot 15\cdot 15 \\  & =225\cdot 15 \\  & =3\,375\end{aligned}
$$

q-69413.name: Question 7
q-69413.worked_solution:
To work out ${(\frac{5}{2})}^{3},$ we multiply $\frac{5}{2}$ by itself and then multiply the result by $\frac{5}{2}$ again:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{5}{2})}^{3} & =\frac{5}{2}\cdot \frac{5}{2}\cdot \frac{5}{2} \\  & =\frac{5\cdot 5\cdot 5}{2\cdot 2\cdot 2} \\  & =\frac{125}{8}\end{aligned}
$$

q-186209.worked_solution:
